newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bridgestone lifts '97 tyre output forecast.
newsitem.headline: Bridgestone lifts '97 tyre output forecast.

text.p: Bridgestone Corp said on Wednesday it had revised up its forecast for tyre production in 1997 to 570,000 tonnes from an initial estimate of 540,000 tonnes made in February.
The company's tyre output in 1996 was a record 560,000 tonnes.
The increase reflects better-than-expected tyre exports, backed by a weaker yen against the dollar, and good tyre demand for new cars ahead of April 1 when Japan's consumption tax was raised.

"Stronger-than-expected tyre output in the first half of this year prompted us to change our forecast, although we expect slower demand for tyres in the second half of this year," a company spokesman said.
